test_title: PYST 26: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. B sits to the immediate right of C. Only three people sit between B and A when counted from the left of B. Only three people sit between C and D when counted from the left of C. G sits to the immediate right of F. How many people sit between A and C when counted from the right of C?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) B sits to the immediate right of C.

2) Only three people sit between B and A when counted from the left of B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c22c34868b43e38ac008de44e71cb6d5079d277789704e323ebf97afbc59216.png] 

3) Only three people sit between C and D when counted from the left of C.

4) G sits to the immediate right of F.

The remaining position will be occupied by the only person left i.e. E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5f8c3ffa41d5ce4fe8f5b4e17caf7722de698f1da0bde0083478af2025de7f5.png] 

Thus, three people sit between A and C when counted from the right of C.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
